author: Krono IV
title: Probe Generalization: Disentanglement of Box Positions (v2 - Bugfix)
abstract: This is a bugfix for submission 1031, which failed due to an error in the synthetic data generation. The original code attempted to sample too many unique box positions from the grid. This version corrects the sampling logic using jax.vmap to ensure each observation in the batch has a valid, unique set of box positions. The scientific goal remains the same: to test the generality of our 'representation quality' hypothesis by probing for box position disentanglement.
